name: AMRUT 2.0
complaint_domains: Water supply; sewerage; septage; parks; water bodies; reuse

name: Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban 2.0
complaint_domains: Solid waste; sanitation; toilets; ODF++; dumpsites; used-water management

name: PMAY-U 2.0

name: DAY-NULM
complaint_domains: Urban livelihoods; SHGs; skills; street vendors; homeless shelters

name: PM SVANidhi
what_it_does: Credit support and related incentives for eligible street vendors; local vending rules and verification still apply.
